messages.text: My pookie bear. She is like the embodiment of heaven on earth. Like the warmth of sunshine. The flowers blooming in the spring. The sound of the rain hitting the window on a cozy day. The fresh, crisp morning air on a 60 degree day. She’s like all of those feelings all at once. She has the most infectious laugh with the most perfect personality. The kind of things that make you forget you were ever upset in the first place when you’re in a bad mood. And when she laughs, you can’t help but laugh with her. When you see her face and eyes light up with joy, it’s like staring at the purest happiness you’ve ever seen. She has the most pure soul. She’s the kind of person who will give company to the old man or woman sitting alone at the café. She’s the kind of person who will give up whatever she can to help the person in need, even when no one is there to witness it. The feeling she gives me is indescribable, but I can only attempt to put it into words. It’s like the most gentle, pure love you could ever imagine. She loves so deeply and effortlessly, like she was born with the ability to love to the fullest. Her beautiful green eyes feel like home to me. She makes me a better person every single day. Despite anything she ever goes through, she still looks out at the world with so much love. Her compassion is unmatched, even though she has faced the feeling of others’ heartlessness in her life. Her passion to love and care is unlike any other. I cannot wait to look out at her in our future, seeing her with our future children, and tell myself how proud I am of the person she is and the mother she will be. Not only that, I cannot wait to make her proud. I can’t wait to love her and our family so deeply, support them, live for them, and do everything I physically can for them. She is the biggest blessing of my life, the answer to every single one of my prayers. My biggest support. I truly cannot thank her enough for everything she’s done for me. I am so unbelievably grateful to be able to say she’s one true love. I am forever indebted to her. Forever and Always my Pookie Bear. I will love you forever and always. <3
